title: Tech Overview
subtitle: A factory-ready template with power, machines, logistics, multiblocks, Lens, HoloMap, and runtime guidance.
summary: A clean tech-progression starter focused on power, machines, multiblocks, logistics, diagnostics, and readable factory onboarding.
body:
Open Terminal, read Power Basics, build generation and storage, process a material, then connect logistics.

First 30 minutes:
- Open Terminal and read the Power Basics Index page.
- Build or spawn-test a starter generator and battery.
- Place a first machine and inspect its status text.
- Use RuntimeGuard guidance before scaling automation.

First 2 hours:
- Process the first material through an Industrial Nexus machine.
- Place a logistics depot and request a basic item flow.
- Validate a small multiblock and document failure reasons in Index.
